newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson Lufkin says Q2 income was record.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson Lufkin says Q2 income was record.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Inc said Monday that its second quarter net income rose to a record $100.2 million, topping a previous record of $97.0 million, set in the comparable period a year ago.
The company also said total revenues for the quarter rose to a record $1.1 billion compared to $991.2 million last year.
The figure marked the first time in the company's history that revenues exceeded $1 billion, DLJ said.
Net income for the current quarter also represented a 16 percent increase over the $86.4 million, or $1.35 per share, DLJ reported for the first quarter of 1997.
Earnings per primary share rose to $1.54 from $1.53 a year ago, but fell to $1.49 from $1.53 on a fully diluted basis.
DLJ cited strong fee income, primarily from mergers and acquisitions, private fund capital raising assignments and management fees from merchant banking funds, for the improved quarterly results.
The firm said underwriting income and trading gains were lower than last year, matching industrywide trends.
